title: Treaty of Lancaster, 1744
authors: Oklahoma State University Library digital transcription
lineage: Inspected indicated passages; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: The proceedings report Tachanoontia presented a wampum string in speech at Lancaster; later in the same speech he recalled an earlier boundary treaty associated with a belt. This is a colonial English-language report with an interpreter, not a full record of Haudenosaunee protocol.
